I'm checking the coordinates for residue E162's backbone and side chain atoms against nearby candidate residues like W165 to figure out spatial proximity.

Working through W165's ring atoms, I find the closest contact is around 3.5 Å from CG of E162 to the tryptophan ring's CZ2/CH2 atoms. I then check H166 and other residues (E223, I68, R295) but their coordinates place them much farther away, so W165 looks like the closest match.
